en.d: Along the very top of the screen is a tab for each Rush club you belong to. The highlighted tab is the club you're currently in.
Click the tab of the club you want to switch to — here, "Coastal Rush".
You're now in the new club — the logo, courses and CPD all update to that club. Switch back the same way anytime.

en.doneD: Use the tabs at the top to move between any Rush clubs you belong to. Each club keeps its own courses, content and CPD progress.
